name: assets/hero_cover
prompt: [PURPOSE]: Academic paper blog cover illustration. [STYLE]: Dreamlike watercolor illustration, wet-on-wet washes, Art Nouveau flowing organic lines, bleeding watercolor edges with visible paper grain texture, golden-leaf sparkle particles. [SUBJECT]: On the left, a vast swirling river made of countless tiny lines of chat text and dialogue bubbles flows across a lavender-violet night sky with soft clouds and stars. The river narrows and funnels into one thin luminous golden stream that pours into a small glowing translucent 8x8 crystal lattice cube resting on a delicate golden grid plane at bottom right; inside the cube a tiny constellation of captured starlight is preserved. A faint thin arc of light loops from the cube up toward a translucent silhouette of a meditating human head halo, suggesting stored memory steering thought. [COLOR]: lavender (#a855f7), deep violet night sky, coral pink (#fb7185) accents, mint teal (#34d399) sparkles, golden amber (#fbbf24), cream paper grain. [COMPOSITION]: Split composition: left = abundant flowing river of text; right = tiny concentrated crystal memory state. No text, no letters, no watermark, no signature.

name: figures/ai_arch
prompt: Create a PROFESSIONAL publication-quality academic architecture diagram, CVPR/NeurIPS style, clean pure white background, flat vector look, subtle same-family gradients, rounded rectangles, thin colored borders, sans-serif labels (Arial), thick dark-gray arrows (5px) with large filled arrowheads, every arrow labeled, no crossings, left-to-right flow. THREE groups: (A) LEFT gray group titled 'Frozen LLM Backbone' containing three small boxes 'Q', 'K', 'V' feeding a wide box 'Attention', then box 'Output'. (B) CENTER lavender group titled 'delta-mem': box 'Memory Projections' with sublabel 'q, k, v'; arrow labeled 'hidden state x_t' FROM backbone TO 'Memory Projections'; box 'Read' with sublabel 'r = S q'; a small 8x8 grid icon labeled 'Online State S (8x8)' with arrow labeled 'query' INTO 'Read'; box 'Low-Rank Steering' with two sub-boxes 'dq' and 'do'; arrow labeled 'read signal r' FROM 'Read' TO 'Low-Rank Steering'; arrow labeled '+ to query' FROM 'dq' TO the 'Q' box in backbone; arrow labeled '+ to output' FROM 'do' TO the 'Output' box in backbone; box 'Gated Delta Write' with sublabel 'erase then write'; arrow labeled 'k, v' FROM 'Memory Projections' TO 'Gated Delta Write'; arrow labeled 'update S' FROM 'Gated Delta Write' TO the 8x8 grid icon. (C) RIGHT amber panel titled 'Writing Granularity' with three stacked mini-panels labeled 'TSW: every token', 'SSW: per message', 'MSW: parallel states', each drawn as a tiny chain of squares. Color coding: backbone gray, projections blue (#2563EB), memory state purple (#7C3AED), steering green (#10B981), write orange (#EA580C). No shadows, no glow, no 3D, no decorative icons, no watermark.

name: figures/ai_paradigms
prompt: Create a PROFESSIONAL publication-quality academic conceptual comparison figure, CVPR style, clean white background, 2x2 grid of four equal panels separated by thin gray lines, flat vector icons, sans-serif captions, muted coordinated palette, no glow, no 3D, no watermark. Panel 1 (top-left) caption 'Textual Memory (TMM)': icon of paper scrolls and text snippets being copied as extra tokens into a long context window bar. Panel 2 (top-right) caption 'Outside-Channel Memory (OMM)': icon of an external database cylinder connected by a retrieval arrow that bypasses around a model box and fuses late. Panel 3 (bottom-left) caption 'Parametric Memory (PMM)': icon of a frozen weight matrix grid with a small static low-rank adapter chip attached, labeled 'static after training'. Panel 4 (bottom-right, highlighted with a soft violet rounded border and faint lavender fill) caption 'delta-mem (Ours)': icon of a tiny recurrent 8x8 state matrix with a circular self-update arrow, wired DIRECTLY into an attention block inside the model, labeled 'online state steers attention'. Each panel has a one-line small caption under the icon. Arrows thick and dark with clear heads. Consistent icon scale across panels.

name: figures/ai_granularity
prompt: Create a PROFESSIONAL publication-quality academic diagram, CVPR style, clean white background, three horizontal panels side by side, flat vector, sans-serif labels, thick dark arrows with filled heads, no glow, no 3D, no watermark. Panel 1 titled 'Token-State Write (TSW)': a row of four small blue squares labeled x1 x2 x3 x4, each with a downward arrow into a corresponding purple state square S1 S2 S3 S4 chained left-to-right by arrows; caption 'write at every token'. Panel 2 titled 'Sequence-State Write (SSW)': tokens grouped by dashed rounded boxes [x1 x2] [x3] [x4 x5 x6], each group with ONE downward arrow labeled 'mean' into state squares S1 S2 S3 chained; caption 'one write per message'. Panel 3 titled 'Multi-State Write (MSW)': one token square x_t fanning out with three arrows into three parallel purple state squares S(1) S(2) S(3), each producing a readout r(1) r(2) r(3) that merge with arrows into one box labeled 'concat'; caption 'parallel sub-states reduce interference'. Color coding: tokens blue (#2563EB), states purple (#7C3AED), readouts green (#10B981). Consistent sizes, balanced whitespace.

name: figures/ai_recovery
prompt: [PURPOSE]: Academic paper blog conceptual illustration. [STYLE]: Dreamlike watercolor, wet-on-wet washes, bleeding edges, visible paper grain, golden sparkle particles, same aesthetic as a lavender night-sky watercolor painting. [SUBJECT]: Left side: a ghostly half-erased parchment scroll whose lines of text are fading into mist, with faint question marks floating above it (the explicit context is gone). Center: a small glowing translucent 8x8 amethyst crystal lattice cube holding tiny captured stars. Right side: from the cube, golden threads of light re-weave themselves into a luminous answer bubble and a small reconstructed fragment of text, showing memory recovered from the compressed state. [COLOR]: lavender (#a855f7), deep violet, coral pink accents, mint sparkles, golden amber (#fbbf24), cream paper. [COMPOSITION]: Left-to-right narrative flow: erased context -> compressed state -> recovered answer. No readable text, no letters, no watermark.
